title: Desktop first-run screen: three steps end to end in the app from source, Done records the pick and opens Settings › AI accounts on that row, Help reopens it
steps: S1: read GET <stand>/api/desktop/config; launch the desktop app from source (test/e2e/launch.mjs) on the stand with TRACY_DESKTOP_ONBOARDING=again in a fresh profile, sign in with a session cookie minted from the stand web container's SESSION_SECRET for ceo@tracy.ai, load the stand's root.
S2: the overlay [data-tracy-onboard] has role=dialog and three step buttons ([data-rail-step] in the setup-rail layout, .tv-ob-bar in the one-column layout).

S3: step 1 lists one [data-agent] card per catalogue id; tracyDesktop.app.agents.detect(catalogue ids) until scanComplete; when some are found, the cards marked data-found=true and the section count equal the found ids.
S4: click the codex card ([data-agent=codex]), Continue ([data-action=next]); step 2: click [data-theme-pick=dark] then [data-theme-pick=system] then [data-theme-pick=light]; Continue.
S5: step 3 shows [data-action=notify] and [data-action=send-test]; read app.notifications.status(), click send-test, read status() again.
S6: Done ([data-action=next]); read <profile>/preferences.json; wait for Settings › AI accounts.
S7: close and relaunch the same profile without TRACY_DESKTOP_ONBOARDING; then click the app menu item id tracy-getting-started (Help › Getting started with Tracy Cowork) from the main process.
expect: S1: catalogue is a non-empty list of {id, name, homepage}; the page sees tracyDesktop.app.protocolVersion 2.
S2: [data-tracy-onboard] present, role=dialog, exactly 3 step buttons.
S3: every catalogue id has a card; found count on screen = found ids from detect; claude found on this machine.
S4: after Continue data-step-index is 1; body[data-ds-dark-theme] true after Dark, false after System and after Light; after Continue data-step-index is 2.
S5: both controls present; the second status() answers with supported true and lastShownAt a number newer than before (or supported false and lastShownAt unchanged).

S6: the overlay is gone; preferences.json onboarding.closedAt is a number, outcome 'completed', picked 'codex'; the address carries settings=ai-accounts&vendor=codex and the focused element sits in [data-vendor=codex].
S7: no [data-tracy-onboard] after the relaunch; after the menu click [data-tracy-onboard] is back.
fence: The first-run screen is device-local: it shows until closed, Done writes completed + the pick to preferences.json and nothing reopens it but Help › Getting started.
